data.one_liner: A customizable pagination widget with numbered page buttons and navigation arrows.
data.what_it_does: MaterialPagination provides a flexible pagination control widget for Flutter applications. It supports numbered page buttons, next and previous arrows, visible page range configuration, and customizable colors, fonts, and sizes.
use_when: You need to add a page navigation bar to your list or grid views.
You want customizable pagination buttons with active and inactive styling.
avoid_when: You need infinite scrolling or lazy loading instead of page-based navigation.
You require complex state management solutions built directly into the widget.
strengths: Highly customizable button size, style, colors, and border radius.
Supports configurable visible page counts and navigation arrows.
weaknesses: Limited to standard page number pagination controls.
Does not manage data fetching or list loading out of the box.

alternatives.name: dots_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose dots_indicator if you are building a page view indicator rather than a numbered pagination bar.
